# Age Calculator

> > Free online age calculator providing instant age calculations, date conversions, and time difference analysis with specialized tools for pets, health metrics, and astronomical data.

Age Calculator is a comprehensive web-based toolkit for age-related calculations and date analysis. The platform offers multiple specialized calculators including pet age converters, heart rate assessments, birthday tracking, and astrological information, available in multiple languages.

## Key Topics

- Age calculation
- Date of birth
- Birthday calculator
- Time difference
- Pet age converter
- Heart rate by age
- Zodiac signs
- Moon phases
- Birth year finder
- Online calculator
- Date calculator
- Interactive tool
- Free tool
- Aries through Virgo zodiac signs
- Lunar phase data

## Core Age Calculation Tools

- [Age Calculator](https://age-calculator.org): Homepage for Age Calculator, free online tool for calculating age and time differences between dates.
- [How old am I today?](https://age-calculator.org/how-old-am-i-today): Calculate your exact age today with Age Calculator showing years, months, weeks, days.
- [What year was I born?](https://age-calculator.org/what-year-was-i-born): Reverse age calculator to find birth year given current age using age-calculator.org.
- [Future Age Calculator](https://age-calculator.org/future-age-calculator): Calculate future age at a specific date using Future Age Calculator tool.
- [Birthday Calculator](https://age-calculator.org/birthday-calculator): Birthday Calculator showing days until next birthday and age at next birthday.

## Pet & Animal Age Calculators

- [Dog Age Calculator](https://age-calculator.org/dog-age-calculator): Dog Age Calculator converting canine years to human years by size and weight.
- [Cat Age Calculator](https://age-calculator.org/cat-age-calculator): Cat Age Calculator converting feline age to human years equivalent.

## Health & Wellness Calculators

- [Heart Rate by Age Calculator](https://age-calculator.org/heart-rate-by-age): Heart Rate by Age Calculator for resting, maximum, target and fat-burning rates.

## Astronomical & Astrological Tools

- [Zodiac Sign Calculator](https://age-calculator.org/zodiac-sign-calculator): Zodiac Sign Calculator identifying astrological sign from birth date.
- [Birthday Moon Phase Calculator](https://age-calculator.org/birthday-moon-phase-calculator): Birthday Moon Phase Calculator showing lunar phase at your birth date.

## International Versions

- [Calculadora de edad (Spanish)](https://age-calculator.org/es): Spanish language version of Age Calculator for calculating age and time differences.
- [Altersrechner (German)](https://age-calculator.org/de): German language version of Age Calculator (Altersrechner) for age calculations.
- [Kor és dátum kalkulátor (Hungarian)](https://age-calculator.org/hu): Hungarian language version of Age Calculator for age and date calculations.
